task_completion.description: Open the Customer Shipment (Shipment (Customer)) window in the GardenWorld Client.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The GardenWorld application is open with a window titled 'Shipment (Customer)' or 'Shipment (Customer) / Receipt' visible.

task_completion.description: Select 'C&W Construction' as the Business Partner for the shipment header.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Business Partner' field in the shipment header contains the text 'C&W Construction'.

task_completion.description: Add a shipment line for 25 units of 'Azalea Bush'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A line item in the 'Shipment Line' tab or grid showing Product: 'Azalea Bush' and Movement Quantity: '25'.

task_completion.description: Add a shipment line for 10 units of 'Elm Tree'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A line item in the 'Shipment Line' tab or grid showing Product: 'Elm Tree' and Movement Quantity: '10'.

task_completion.description: Complete the shipment document using the document action button.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Doc Status' field changes to 'Completed' (CO) or a dialog box confirms the document action was successful, often triggered by a 'Complete' button.

integrity.description: The agent used the GardenWorld GUI to perform the task rather than command-line database manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the GardenWorld Client menus, fields, and buttons.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply type the final status into a field but followed the workflow.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the transition from 'Draft' status to 'Completed' status after clicking the action button.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual GardenWorld software environment.
integrity.visual_evidence: The GardenWorld logo, standard ERP window headers, and specific field labels (Business Partner, Product, Movement Qty) are visible.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Business Partner must be exactly 'C&W Construction'. The two required products are 'Azalea Bush' (Quantity: 25) and 'Elm Tree' (Quantity: 10). The task is only finished when the document status is moved to 'Completed'.
